overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong and highly specialized professional presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon, reaching a combined audience of 3,580 followers. Content focusing on computational social science, disinformation, and coordinated inauthentic behavior resonates deeply with his academic and technical audience, yielding robust engagement metrics across all three networks.

contentThemes.description: Research, algorithms, and tool updates (like CooRnet) dedicated to identifying coordinated link sharing on social media platforms.
Announcements regarding job openings, postdoc hires, and PhD research opportunities in computational social science.
Discussions and conference presentations focused on the methodological approaches to studying multi-platform disinformation.

recommendations: Capitalize on the high engagement on Bluesky by sharing more frequent, informal updates on ongoing research and methodology.
Leverage LinkedIn's larger reach to amplify professional milestones, funding news, and job openings, while prompting comments to boost algorithmic visibility.
Include direct links to publications, GitHub repositories, or project websites to translate high engagement into actionable traffic.

platformInsights.bluesky: Acts as the most engaging hub relative to audience size (averaging 6.14% engagement per post), with high repost rates indicating a strong network effect among academic peers.
platformInsights.mastodon: Attracts a highly specialized audience interested in technical tools and open methodologies, as evidenced by positive reception to the CooRnet v2.0 release.
platformInsights.linkedin: Represents the largest community and drives the highest absolute engagement volume, making it the premier channel for institutional announcements and recruitment.
